nodes.rationale: 計画・設計の各分岐を一つずつ解消し共有理解に達するまで問い詰める

nodes.label: FileSystemService abstraction
nodes.rationale: Tauri API をインターフェース経由で抽象化し、ServicesProvider でモック注入可能にする

nodes.label: State management (useState, SWR, Context, useTransition)
nodes.rationale: 画像ナビゲーションには useTransition を使わない（体感パフォーマンス低下）

nodes.label: Rust thumbnail generation backend
nodes.rationale: Lanczos3 + BLAKE3 + OS cache でメモリ削減と高速スクロールを実現する

nodes.label: Tauri PathResolver app_cache_dir for thumbnails
nodes.rationale: directories クレートより依存性を減らし設定と一貫させる

nodes.label: useThumbnail hook transparent Rust integration
nodes.rationale: 既存フックのインターフェースを変えず内部実装のみ差し替え（破壊的変更回避）

nodes.label: assetProtocol $CACHE/** scope
nodes.rationale: カスタムプロトコルなしで 403 Forbidden（キャッシュ読取拒否）を解決する

nodes.label: Feature-Based Architecture
nodes.rationale: Features under src/features/[name]/ with index.ts as sole public API; no cross-feature internal imports or cycles; shared code in src/shared/.

nodes.label: Quality Gates
nodes.rationale: Commits blocked unless pnpm tauri build, type-check, lint, and test all pass.

nodes.label: Dependency Injection via useServices
nodes.rationale: External APIs behind ServiceContext; tests inject mocks via ServicesProvider; no direct @tauri-apps/* outside adapters.

nodes.label: Test Pyramid Strategy
nodes.rationale: Unit (Vitest) → integration with mock services → component tests of user behavior; colocated __tests__/.

nodes.label: No useTransition for Image Navigation
nodes.rationale: useTransition on image navigation degrades UX; ImageViewer must receive key on folder change.

nodes.label: ADR-001 Action Result Pattern
nodes.rationale: Replace ActionContext God Object; actions return ActionResult | null; applyResult centralizes React side effects. Accepted 2026-03-15 for Issue #29.

nodes.label: applyResult
nodes.rationale: Maps ActionResult to ResultApplier side effects; sole rewrite target for Zustand migration (Issue #20).

nodes.label: ActionDependencies vs ResultApplier Split
nodes.rationale: Read-side deps (fss, openImageFile, currentTheme) separated from write-side applier (startTransition, setAppState, setTheme) to fix ISP and DI duplication.

nodes.label: ADR-002 Lazy Archive Extraction
nodes.rationale: Split list_images_in_container into list_image_handles + resolve_images_in_range to avoid full ZIP extract CPU spikes. Accepted 2026-06-01. Prefetch out of scope (P3).

nodes.label: Two-Phase Container API
nodes.rationale: Phase1 listHandles (ZIP central directory only); Phase2 resolveRange (chunk extract). Frontend unaware of folder vs ZIP.

nodes.label: ImageHandle
nodes.rationale: index + name only; no diskPath so phase1 cannot force extraction at compile time.

nodes.label: ImageContainer listHandles/resolveRange
nodes.rationale: Breaking change: remove listImages(); ImageViewer takes container prop; chunk policy in LocalFolderContainer via ContainerConfig.

nodes.label: ADR-002 Milestone True Lazy Loading
nodes.rationale: Backend/API largely done but useImages still resolveRange(0, handles.length); UI CPU spike goal unmet until chunked resolve.

nodes.label: Archive Support MVP Scope
nodes.rationale: ZIP only, read-only; frontend sees temp extract path so users need not distinguish archive vs folder.

nodes.label: Scattered State Management
nodes.rationale: High priority: App.tsx useState+useTransition holds global AppState; prop drilling; scale risk. Zustand evaluation referenced elsewhere.

nodes.label: shared→features Dependency Inversion Issue
nodes.rationale: ServiceContext and useImages import from folder-navigation; reverse dependency violates clean layering.

nodes.label: Container-First Testing Strategy 2026-05
nodes.rationale: Mocks centralized; Partial FileSystemService done; vocabulary shifted folder→container; ImageViewer behavior tests still thin.

nodes.label: FileSystemService Mock Factory Unification
nodes.rationale: High-priority factory unify largely done; remaining: type-error detection on FS API changes, shared ServicesProvider wrapper, Tauri mock reset split.

nodes.label: Thumbnail System Encapsulation Violation
nodes.rationale: Frontend knows batch/priority/cache details (batchCreateThumbnails visibleCount); couples display to backend optimization strategy.

nodes.label: Vitest 4 vi.fn Generic Typing
nodes.rationale: Approach B: declare with vi.fn<T>() and re-init in beforeEach with same type args; avoid Mock<T> double annotation.

nodes.label: Remove Manual Memoization Spec
nodes.rationale: Delete useMemo/useCallback from 3 hooks + Sidebar after React Compiler; FR-001–008; SC ±5% perf, 100% tests, 15% LOC cut.

nodes.label: React Compiler Auto-Optimization
nodes.rationale: Compiler memoizes computations and stable callbacks; keeping manual memoization is redundant and may conflict.

nodes.label: Memoization Removal API Contracts Unchanged
nodes.rationale: Public hook/component TypeScript signatures remain identical; internal refactor only.

nodes.label: ThemeProvider
nodes.rationale: Replace custom ThemeProvider with shadcn/ui theme-provider; manage theme state and context for light/dark only

nodes.label: Theme
nodes.rationale: Union type light|dark only; system removed; default dark

nodes.label: shadcn/ui Theme Provider
nodes.rationale: Industry standard with localStorage; smaller maintenance surface than custom provider

nodes.label: System Theme Removal
nodes.rationale: Eliminate resolvedTheme complexity; simplify toggle and tests; personal app can choose manually

nodes.label: resolvedTheme (Removed)
nodes.rationale: Removed with system theme support; migrate to direct theme property

nodes.label: Thumbnail
nodes.rationale: 200x200 resized image cached on disk with metadata for folder sidebar display

nodes.label: Rust image Crate
nodes.rationale: image 0.25 with Lanczos3 resize and JPEG quality 60 for thumbnail generation

nodes.label: rayon Parallel Processing
nodes.rationale: Parallel thumbnail generation up to 4-8 threads to avoid UI blocking

nodes.label: WebKitGTK Image Decode Bottleneck
nodes.rationale: Sync decode+GPU transfer of 5MB images blocks scroll; Rust thumbnails fix root cause

nodes.label: CVE-2025-55182
nodes.rationale: CVSS 10.0 RCE via React Server Functions payload deserialization

nodes.label: CVE-2025-55184
nodes.rationale: CVSS 7.5 DoS via malicious HTTP causing infinite loop

nodes.label: CVE-2025-55183
nodes.rationale: CVSS 5.3 Server Function source exposure risk

nodes.label: React Compiler 1.0.0
nodes.rationale: Upgrade from babel-plugin-react-compiler RC to stable for long-term maintenance

nodes.label: Phased React Upgrade Strategy
nodes.rationale: Four phases with Git commits for rollback: security patch, compiler stable, testing library, optional 19.2.3

nodes.label: No Application Code Changes Contract
nodes.rationale: Feature updates only package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml; application and Rust source must remain unchanged.

nodes.label: Flex Layout with min-height:0 Decision
nodes.rationale: CSS flex + min-height:0 enables child overflow without JS height measurement; JS innerHeight rejected for Tauri multi-platform complexity.

nodes.label: Viewer Overflow Zoom-Only Decision
nodes.rationale: Default overflow:hidden; enable overflow:auto only when zoom exceeds 1x and content overflows; always-auto rejected because scrollbars appear at 1x.

nodes.label: Independent Sidebar Scroll Decision
nodes.rationale: Sidebar always overflow-y:auto with min-height:0; shared main-content scroll rejected because it would scroll the viewer.

nodes.label: Thumbnail Optimization Information Hiding Violation
nodes.rationale: Frontend knows batch size, priority, and image-path collection; move strategy into Rust so folder path alone yields thumbnails.

nodes.label: TDD RED-GREEN-BLUE Migration
nodes.rationale: Commit1 RED tests, Commit2 GREEN with old APIs coexist, Commit3 BLUE delete getOrCreateThumbnail/batchCreateThumbnails and unregister Rust commands.

nodes.label: CommandError Dual Definition Concern
nodes.rationale: Separate CommandError types in error.rs and image_container.rs leave Service return types undefined; unify on image_container expanded variant before Service work.

nodes.label: ImageContainer Trait Granularity
nodes.rationale: Decide whether list_images and get_thumbnail share one Trait or split (ListImages/GetThumbnail) to avoid Interface Segregation violations as methods grow.
